summary: Iteration 66: verified this session's 3 backlog items — Tax Receipts Label (backend), Handle Availability Nudge (frontend), Storefront Themes scope chip (frontend), and Dashboard Claim Handle Banner personalized copy (frontend). Tax receipt renderer: ts-node script stubs mailTransporter and invokes sendOrderReceiptEmail with 4 fixtures (GB VAT 20% / DE reverse-charge VAT / SG GST 9% / ES IVA 21%). All 4 fixtures PASS: per-country tax label appears verbatim, rate percentage renders inline (e.g. 'VAT (20%)', 'GST (9%)', 'IVA (21%)'), 'Reverse-charge (EU B2B)' note appears only for the DE reverse-charge order, and the 'Merchant <label> ID: <id>' row appears iff merchantVatId is passed (present for GB/DE/ES, absent for SG). Fulfillment code path in orderFulfillmentService.ts confirmed via view_file: resolves merchantVatId via dynamic import('./companyTaxService').resolveTaxSettings(userId, order.company_id) then forwards it to both sendOrderReceiptEmail and sendOrderReceiptMerchantEmail. Frontend (Playwright, hostbay@moxx.co): /dashboard claim-handle-banner HIDDEN (single company already claims @hostbay) ✓; /storefront handle-claim-nudge HIDDEN both without the localStorage flag AND after injecting dp_new_company_handle_nudge:<cid>=1 (correct — profile.handle='hostbay' so nudge stays hidden by the AND condition) ✓; creator-theme-scope-chip renders with exact text 'Applies to this company only' inside creator-theme-section ✓; storefront-company-hint chip still shows ✓; 0 console errors on /dashboard and /storefront (non-favicon).
critical_code_review_comments: orderEmails.ts::renderOrderItemsTable correctly (a) trims/falls-back the tax_label to 'Tax', (b) inlines the rate percentage only when >0 (Number.isFinite && >0), (c) emits the reverse-charge row only when order.reverse_charge truthy, (d) uses the same tax_label acronym inside the 'Merchant <label> ID' row so the label matches the totals row.

orderFulfillmentService.ts uses dynamic import for companyTaxService (avoids circular deps) and catches taxErr to a warn log so a tax-lookup failure never blocks receipt delivery — good defensive coding.

HandleClaimNudge.tsx trigger logic uses NUDGE_KEY_PREFIX + companyId AND profile.handle empty AND !storefront_pending — matches spec; component correctly no-ops when handle already exists, which is why the flag injection test showed HIDDEN state as expected.
CreateCompanyModal.tsx writes dp_new_company_handle_nudge:<newCompanyId>=1 then calls selectCompany(newCompanyId) after addCompany success — verified via grep.
PageTab.tsx imports and renders <HandleClaimNudge/> after the OnboardingBanner — verified.

ClaimHandleBanner.tsx is correctly HIDDEN on hostbay because the account has only ONE company AND that company has a handle — cannot positively verify the personalized 'Reserve <CompanyName>'s handle' copy without creating a second company on the live DB (out of scope in SAFE MODE).
